title: Autoregressive Multimodal Anomaly Detection with Large Language Models for Microservice Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.31722v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Microservice systems have become a dominant architecture for large-scale cloud applications, enabling rapid deployment and elastic scaling. However, ensuring the reliability and availability of microservice systems critically relies on effective anomaly detection, as failures and performance anomalies can quickly propagate across services and severely impact end-to-end system behavior. Existing multimodal anomaly detection approaches for microservice systems often struggle with two fundamental limitations: (i) the neglect of modality-specific characteristics in favor of cross-modality fusion, and (ii) the "identity-shortcut" problem that affects the feature reconstruction process. translated_abstract: 微服务系统已成为大规模云应用的主流架构，支持快速部署和弹性伸缩。然而，确保微服务系统的可靠性和可用性关键依赖于有效的异常检测，因为故障和性能异常会在服务之间快速传播，严重影响端到端的系统行为。现有的微服务系统多模态异常检测方法通常面临两个根本性的局限：（i）为了跨模态融合而忽略了模态特定的特征，以及（ii）影响特征重构过程的“身份捷径”问题。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了LLMMAD，一个基于大语言模型的微服务系统自回归多模态异常检测框架。首先，为了协调跨模态融合与模态特定特征的保留，LLMMAD将（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了LLMMAD，一个基于大语言模型的自回归多模态异常检测框架，通过在跨模态融合中保留模态特定特征并解决“身份捷径”问题，来提升微服务系统的异常检测效果。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes LLMMAD, an autoregressive multimodal anomaly detection framework based on Large Language Models, which improves anomaly detection in microservice systems by preserving modality-specific characteristics during cross-modality fusion and addressing the identity-shortcut problem.
